qualification.details: Qualification: A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed, from a recognized University; A Ph. D Degree in concerned/ allied/ relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with evidence of published work; A minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based Performance based Appraisal System (PBAS) as set in the regulation in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of Professors in Colleges; A minimum of 10 research Publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; A minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II at Table-2 (UGC guideline 20-07-2018) Experience: Associate Professor/ Professor with total experience of fifteen years of Teaching/Research/Administration in Universities, colleges and other institutions of higher education Age limit: Maximum 55 years | Other conditions: | Applications must come through proper channel Qualification, experience and norms as prescribed by the latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam Office Memorandum No AHE.45/2019/2, dated 25.02.2019

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam.
Enclose complete Bio-data and all supporting testimonials from HSLC onwards.
Enclose a non-refundable demand draft of Rs. 5000/- drawn in favour of Principal, Darrang College, Tezpur, payable at SBI, Main Branch.
Submit to the President, Governing Body, Darrang College(A), Tezpur, Assam 784001 within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
Make sure it reaches by 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed, from a recognized University; A Ph. D Degree in concerned/ allied/ relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with evidence of published work; A minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based Performance based Appraisal System (PBAS) as set in the regulation in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of Professors in Colleges; A minimum of 10 research Publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; A minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II at Table-2 (UGC guideline 20-07-2018) Experience: Associate Professor/ Professor with total experience of fifteen years of Teaching/Research/Administration in Universities, colleges and other institutions of higher education Age limit: Maximum 55 years Other conditions: Applications must come through proper channel Qualification, experience and norms as prescribed by the latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam Office Memorandum No AHE.45/2019/2, dated 25.02.2019

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Darrang College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete or defective applications will be rejected at the time of scrutiny and no call letter will be issued to such candidates

content_sections.text: The term of Principal shall be five (5) years as per Govt. guidelines

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Darrang College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Darrang College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam) and send it to President, Governing Body, Darrang College(A), Tezpur, Assam 784001, by by post / in person, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Darrang College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 5000 (non-refundable demand draft).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University; Ph.D in concerned/allied/relevant discipline with evidence of published work; Associate Professor/Professor with total 15 years of Teaching/Research/Administration experience; minimum API score under PBAS (Appendix-III); minimum 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; minimum 110 research score as per Appendix-II, Table-2 (UGC guideline 20-07-2018).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications must come through proper channel. Qualification, experience and norms as prescribed by the latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam Office Memorandum No AHE.45/2019/2, dated 25.02.2019.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete or defective applications will be rejected at the time of scrutiny and no call letter will be issued to such candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The term of Principal shall be five (5) years as per Govt. guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Darrang College, Tezpur, Sonitpur, Assam.
